appDesc.message: Automatically deletes browsing history for domains you choose, so they stay out of the address bar and history.

toggleAllTitle.message: Turn the extension on or off

blockedNow.message: $DOMAIN$ blocked. Cleaning up past history too.

unblockedNow.message: $DOMAIN$ unblocked. Visits from now on will be recorded.

removedNow.message: $DOMAIN$ removed. Visits from now on will be recorded.

addedNow.message: $DOMAIN$ added. Cleaning up past history too.

turnedOff.message: Turned off. History will be kept.

errFull.message: Storage limit reached — chrome.storage.sync holds 512 items. Remove a domain you no longer need.

lede.message: Deletes visits to the domains you list — and their subdomains — the moment they are recorded. They disappear from address bar autocomplete and from chrome://history alike.

migratedNoDate.message: Migrated entry — no record of when it was added

domainsNote.message: Paste a whole URL and only the domain is kept. Adding example.com also covers www.example.com and m.example.com.

secOmnibox.message: Block straight from the address bar

omniboxNote.message: Type hb in the address bar and press Tab (or Space) — a History Blocklist chip appears on the left. Type a domain and press Enter to block it; if it is already listed, it is unblocked instead. Listed domains also show up as suggestions so you can pick one to unblock.

omniboxBullet1.message: The toolbar badge reports the result — ＋ blocked · － unblocked · ! not a domain

omniboxBullet2.message: To change the keyword, edit omnibox.keyword in manifest.json

sweepDisabled.message: Skipped — the extension is off. Turn it on first.

cleanupNote1.message: When a domain is new, its past history is swept in full automatically — whether you added it here or it arrived from another device over sync. A domain is only swept once; after that the five-minute sweep takes over.

cleanupNote2.message: This button sweeps every listed domain again. You normally never need it — use it if you suspect an automatic sweep was cut short. It can take tens of seconds on a large history.

limitsIntro.message: This extension does not prevent recording; it deletes right after. Chrome has no way to skip recording for a chosen domain. So the following are limits.

limit1.message: There is a window of a few hundred milliseconds where the visit is in history.

limit2.message: Bookmarks, cookies, sessions, cache and saved passwords are left alone.

limit3.message: Search engine suggestions in the address bar come from the server and cannot be blocked.

limit4.message: With Chrome sync on, deletions take a moment to reach your other devices.

omniDefault.message: <dim>History Blocklist</dim> type a domain to block or unblock

omniWillBlock.message: <match>$DOMAIN$</match> <dim>block</dim> — includes subdomains, past history is cleaned too

omniWillUnblock.message: <match>$DOMAIN$</match> <dim>unblock</dim> — visits from now on will be recorded
